versions.content: The function Gpt_DeInit shall deinitialize the hardware used by the GPT driver (depending on configuration) to the power on reset st ate. Values of registers which are not writeable are excluded. It’s the responsibility of the hardware design that the state does not lead to undefined activities in the µC.
